description: This source file implements the BlindSignAuth class, providing methods for obtaining tokens, handling HTTP responses, creating cryptographic requests, processing responses, and fingerprinting public metadata within a cryptographic token issuance system.

classes.name: BlindSignAuth
classes.description: Main class providing cryptographic token operations including token retrieval, response handling, and metadata fingerprinting.

methods.name: GetTokens
methods.description: Initiates the process to obtain cryptographic tokens using an OAuth token and a specified number of tokens.

methods.name: GetInitialDataCallback
methods.description: Handles the response from the initial data request, creating cryptographic requests and proceeding with authentication and signing.

methods.name: AuthAndSignCallback
methods.description: Processes the response from the authentication and signing request, unblinding tokens, and preparing spend token data.

methods.name: FingerprintPublicMetadata
methods.description: Generates a fingerprint hash of the public metadata for integrity verification.
